lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: At least four vertical columns and three horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a localized grid arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal clusters of high-luminance blobs to form rectangular anchor nodes on the mid-lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a distinct distribution of high-luminance blobs across its visible dorsal surface.
